title: Deals Section Architecture
content_full:
# DEALS SECTION ARCHITECTURE

System Architecture: Frontend (Next.js/React) with /deals list page aggregating both institutions and businesses, /deals/new for entity selection, /deals/[id] smart router detecting entity type and redirecting to institution or business detail page, /deals/[id]/edit smart router for edit pages.

Data Flow: User navigates to /deals -> parallel API fetch of GET /institutions and GET /businesses -> transform and merge into unified Deal[] -> apply client-side filters (search, entity type, status) -> render table.

Database Schema: Uses existing Institution and Business tables with deal-related fields (deal_date, monthly_amount, commission_type, commission_value, signed_agreement_url, is_exclusive, exclusivity_amount). Sub-entities: InstitutionDealStatus and BusinessDealStatus for pipeline tracking.

Design Patterns: Aggregation Pattern (multiple sources -> single view), Smart Router Pattern (generic route -> type detection -> specific route), Proxy Pattern (unified interface -> delegates to specific implementation), Adapter Pattern (different schemas -> common interface).

Security: All routes protected by JwtAuthGuard and RolesGuard. Performance: ~100-500 deals total, parallel API calls, client-side filtering.

Design Patterns: Aggregation (multiple sources to single view), Smart Router (generic to specific route), Proxy (unified to specific), Adapter (different schemas to common interface). Security: JWT + Roles guards.

title: Boomerang CRM -- Production Deployment Guide
content_full:
# Boomerang CRM -- Production Deployment Guide

Sections: Pre-Deployment Checklist, Environment Setup, Database Migration Strategy, Deployment Options, Rollback Procedures, Post-Deployment Verification, Monitoring & Alerts.

Environment Setup: Backend requires DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, PORT, NODE_ENV, CORS_ORIGINS, RESEND_API_KEY, STUDENT_PORTAL_URL. Frontends require NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL.

Database Migration Strategy: Backup with pg_dump, test on staging, review migration SQL, run prisma migrate deploy. Rollback via pg_restore.

Deployment Options:
1. Docker Compose (self-hosted) - VPS, dedicated servers. Resources: 4 cores, 8GB RAM minimum.
2. Vercel + Railway (recommended for MVP) - Auto-deploy on push.
3. AWS ECS (scalable production) - ECS Fargate, RDS, CloudFront, ElastiCache.
4. Google Cloud Run (serverless) - Auto-scaling, pay-per-use.

Rollback: Docker Compose revert to previous image. Vercel promote previous deployment. Railway redeploy previous.

Post-Deployment: Health checks for all 4 services, smoke tests (auth, CRUD, email), performance checks.

Monitoring: Sentry for errors, uptime monitoring, performance monitoring. Alerts: API downtime, database connectivity, error rate, disk usage.

- Detail Page: Status-dependent buttons and fields (potential: convert to active; active: suspend, revert; inactive: reactivate, revert)

Dashboard Testing: KPI cards (Active/Potential Institutions, Businesses, Students, Voucher Redemptions, Pending Approvals), recent activity widget with colored dots and Hebrew descriptions.

Error Scenarios: Network errors (turn off backend), validation errors (empty required fields), auth errors (clear localStorage).

Performance: Dashboard <2s, list <1s, detail <500ms, form submission <1s.

Browser Testing: Chrome, Safari, Firefox. Mobile testing recommended.

title: Boomerang CRM -- Quick Start & Deployment
content_full:
# Boomerang CRM -- Quick Start & Deployment

Project Overview: 4 applications - Backend API (NestJS :3101), CRM Frontend (Next.js :3100), Public Website (Next.js :3102), CMS Admin (Next.js :3103).

Quick Start Options:
1. Manual Setup: Clone, setup backend (.env, npm install, prisma migrate, start:dev), setup each frontend (npm install, npm run dev).
2. Docker Compose (Recommended): cp .env.docker .env, docker-compose up -d, run migrations.

CI/CD Pipeline: CI workflow triggers on push/PR (lint, TypeScript, tests, build, Trivy scan). Staging deploy on push to develop. Production deploy manual with confirmation.

GitHub Secrets Required: STAGING/PRODUCTION DATABASE_URL, API_URL, FRONTEND_URL, JWT_SECRET, RESEND_API_KEY.

Database Management: prisma migrate dev/deploy/status/reset. Seeding: prisma:seed:all or individual seeds.

Architecture: Internet -> Nginx/LB -> Frontends (Next.js) <-> Backend (NestJS) -> PostgreSQL + Prisma.

Monitoring: /health endpoint returning status, database connection, timestamp. Troubleshooting: DB connection, build failures, port conflicts.

title: Lead Conversion Test Guide
content_full:
# Lead Conversion Test Guide

Pre-requisites: Backend running (npm run start:dev), Frontend running (npm run dev), valid admin/operations/area_manager credentials.

Test Scenario 1: Convert from Lead List
- Navigate to leads page, find convertible lead, click convert button, confirm dialog
- Expected: Success toast, redirect to /students/{id}, lead status changed to converted, new student created
- Network: POST /api/leads/{id}/convert-to-student with Authorization Bearer token

Test Scenario 2: Convert from Lead Detail Page
- Navigate to /leads/{id}, click conversion button, confirm
- Expected: Same results plus converted section with student link

Test Scenario 3: Error Handling
- 3A Invalid Auth: Clear localStorage, attempt conversion -> redirect to /login
- 3B Insufficient Permissions: Login as non-admin, attempt -> 403 Forbidden
- 3C Already Converted: Button should be disabled/hidden

Technical Verification: post() method at lines 208-216 in api.ts, usage in leads/page.tsx:34.

Troubleshooting: "api.post is not a function" -> check file saved and dev server restarted. 401 -> re-login. 403 -> check user role. Network error -> check backend port and CORS.
